history.subject:
data(text-min-recovery): post-recovery proposer + downstream artefacts (Phases 1-5)

Proposer recovery for 124 tile-passes (113 unique) reported by audit:
however the recovery turned out to be a no-op at the proposer level
— per-pass geojson md5sums are bit-identical to committed versions,
indicating the failures had already been recovered in a prior round.
The execution_stats.failed_items list is a historical record, not a
current-failure signal. The 124-tile audit count was therefore
misleading.

Refreshed downstream artefacts to N=10K BCa bootstrap with --mcc:
  - Consensus 4-of-5: 10131 -> 10170 (+39 features from new dedup)
  - Crops manifest: +39 newly extracted crops
  - Verifier: 39/39 verified, 0 failed
  - Verified detections: 3861 -> 3865 (+4 retained)
  - F1@50m: 0.7591 -> 0.7595 (delta = 0.0004 ; auto-proceed criterion < 0.005 met)
  - MCC: 0.626 [0.611, 0.641] (newly added)

Recovery cost (proposer): ~$0.144 total ($0.0012/tile, 290x cheaper
than T=0.7 HIGH-thinking recovery at $0.357/tile).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
